name: @pipeworx/mcp-boe-uk

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Fetch one or more Bank of England IADB series by code over a date range. Requires BoE series codes (e.g. IUDBEDR = Bank Rate, IUDSOIA = SONIA, XUDLUSS = USD/GBP, XUDLERS = EUR/GBP). Use list_known_series or the convenience tools (bank_rate, sonia, usd_gbp, eur_gbp) if you do not know the code. Returns parsed JSON: one entry per series with observations [{date, value}].

series_codes.description: BoE series codes, e.g. ["IUDBEDR","IUDSOIA"]. Also accepts a single comma-separated string.

tools.name: bank_rate
tools.description: The Bank of England's official Bank Rate: the current rate, the date it took effect, the previous rate and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history (series IUDBEDR) — not just a raw observations list to infer a decision date from. Also returns the last N daily observations.

tools.name: sonia
tools.description: Latest N observations of SONIA, the Sterling Overnight Index Average (series IUDSOIA), most recent first.

tools.name: usd_gbp
tools.description: Latest N observations of the USD/GBP spot rate — US$ per £1 (series XUDLUSS), most recent first.

tools.name: eur_gbp
tools.description: Latest N observations of the EUR/GBP spot rate — € per £1 (series XUDLERS), most recent first.

tools.name: list_known_series
tools.description: List the friendly BoE series codes this pack surfaces (Bank Rate, SONIA, USD/GBP, EUR/GBP) with their IADB codes.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-boe-uk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the boe-uk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
